```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ex_cat    <- bind_rows(s1_cat, s2_cat)       %>% mutate(group = "Categorization")
ex_sensor <- bind_rows(s1_sensor, s2_sensor) %>% mutate(group = "Sensorimotor")
ex_voe    <- bind_rows(s1_voe, s2_voe)       %>% mutate(group = "VoE")

ex_all <- bind_rows(ex_cat, ex_sensor, ex_voe) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor", "VoE")))

ex_table <- ex_all %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    N                  = n(),
    `T_encode M`       = round(mean(mean_T_encode,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `T_encode SD`      = round(sd(mean_T_encode,      na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_onset M`       = round(mean(mean_RT_onset,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_onset SD`      = round(sd(mean_RT_onset,      na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_critical M`    = round(mean(mean_RT_critical, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_critical SD`   = round(sd(mean_RT_critical,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `ACC M`            = round(mean(mean_ACC,         na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `ACC SD`           = round(sd(mean_ACC,           na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_onset M`      = round(mean(mean_IES_onset,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_onset SD`     = round(sd(mean_IES_onset,     na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_critical M`   = round(mean(mean_IES_critical, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_critical SD`  = round(sd(mean_IES_critical,   na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )

cat("=== 正式实验 Descriptive Statistics ===\n")
print(ex_table)

# 导出
write.csv(ex_table,
          file = file.path(folder_path, "descriptive_ex.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n导出完成！\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 整理数据
plot_dat <- ex_all %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "VoE", "Sensorimotor"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, 
                mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, 
             mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "mean_T_encode"     ~ "T_encode (s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_onset"     ~ "RT_onset (s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_critical"  ~ "RT_critical (s)",
      measure == "mean_ACC"          ~ "ACC (%)",
      measure == "mean_IES_onset"    ~ "IES_onset",
      measure == "mean_IES_critical" ~ "IES_critical"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c("T_encode (s)", "RT_onset (s)", 
                                          "RT_critical (s)", "ACC (%)",
                                          "IES_onset", "IES_critical"))
  )

sem_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(group, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem  = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(data = sem_dat,
                  aes(x = group, y = mean,
                      ymin = mean - sem,
                      ymax = mean + sem),
                  color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Categorization" = "#4E79A7",
                                "VoE"            = "#59A14F",
                                "Sensorimotor"   = "#F28E2B")) +
  labs(title = "Performance by Group (Box Plot with SEM)", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_blank(),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x    = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "boxplot_by_group.png"),
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("图已保存！\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# ── 整理数据 ──────────────────────────────────────────
plot_dat <- ex_all %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "VoE", "Sensorimotor"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical,
                mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical,
             mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "mean_T_encode"     ~ "T[encode]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_onset"     ~ "RT[onset]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_critical"  ~ "RT[critical]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_ACC"          ~ "ACC~('%')",
      measure == "mean_IES_onset"    ~ "IES[onset]",
      measure == "mean_IES_critical" ~ "IES[critical]"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c(
      "T[encode]~(s)", "RT[onset]~(s)", "RT[critical]~(s)",
      "ACC~('%')", "IES[onset]", "IES[critical]"
    ))
  )

# ── Nature 配色 ───────────────────────────────────────
nature_colors <- c(
  "Categorization" = "#4DBBD5",
  "VoE"            = "#00A087",
  "Sensorimotor"   = "#E64B35"
)

# ── 画图 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +

  # 箱线图
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = 19,
```

```{r}
library(car)

# ── 确保列为数值型 ────────────────────────────────────
ex_all$mean_T_encode     <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_T_encode)
ex_all$mean_IES_onset    <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_IES_onset)
ex_all$mean_IES_critical <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_IES_critical)
ex_all$mean_RT_onset     <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_RT_onset)
ex_all$mean_RT_critical  <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_RT_critical)
ex_all$mean_ACC          <- as.numeric(ex_all$mean_ACC)
ex_all$group             <- factor(ex_all$group,
                                   levels = c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor", "VoE"))

# ── 正态性检验 ────────────────────────────────────────
cat("=== Shapiro-Wilk 正态性检验 ===\n")
for (dv in c("mean_IES_onset", "mean_IES_critical",
             "mean_RT_onset", "mean_RT_critical", "mean_ACC", "mean_T_encode")) {
  sw <- shapiro.test(ex_all[[dv]])
  cat(paste0(dv, ": W = ", round(sw$statistic, 4),
             ", p = ", format(sw$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
}

# ── 相关性检验 ────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Pearson 相关：T_encode vs 各 DV ===\n")
dvs <- c("mean_IES_onset", "mean_IES_critical",
         "mean_RT_onset", "mean_RT_critical", "mean_ACC")

for (dv in dvs) {
  result <- cor.test(ex_all$mean_T_encode, ex_all[[dv]])
  cat(paste0("\nT_encode vs ", dv, ":\n"))
  cat(paste0("r = ", round(result$estimate, 3),
             ", t(", result$parameter, ") = ", round(result$statistic, 3),
             ", p = ", format(result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
}

# ── ANCOVA 函数 ───────────────────────────────────────
run_ancova_ex <- function(dv, covariate = NULL) {
  cat(paste0("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("DV = ", dv, "\n"))
  cat(paste0(strrep("=", 50), "\n"))

  # Levene's Test
  cat("\n--- Levene's Test ---\n")
  print(leveneTest(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group")), data = ex_all))

  if (!is.null(covariate)) {
    # 平行性假设
    cat("\n--- 平行性假设 ---\n")
    print(summary(aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group * ", covariate)),
                      data = ex_all)))
    # ANCOVA
    cat("\n--- ANCOVA ---\n")
    model <- aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group + ", covariate)),
                 data = ex_all)
  } else {
    cat("\n--- One-way ANOVA ---\n")
    model <- aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group")), data = ex_all)
  }

  print(summary(model))

  cat("\n--- Type III SS ---\n")
  print(Anova(model, type = "III"))

  cat("\n--- Post-hoc Tukey HSD ---\n")
  print(TukeyHSD(model, "group"))
}

# ── 跑所有 DV ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 根据相关性结果决定是否加协变量，先全部加上，之后可以调整
run_ancova_ex("mean_IES_onset",    covariate = "mean_T_encode")
run_ancova_ex("mean_IES_critical", covariate = "mean_T_encode")
run_ancova_ex("mean_RT_onset",     covariate = "mean_T_encode")
run_ancova_ex("mean_RT_critical",  covariate = "mean_T_encode")
run_ancova_ex("mean_ACC",          covariate = "mean_T_encode")
```
```{r}
#假设检验问题

#正态性：所有 DV 均违反，但 N=765 大样本鲁棒性足够
#方差齐性：IES_onset, IES_critical, RT_onset, RT_critical 均违反；ACC 满足 ✓
#平行性假设：IES_onset, IES_critical, RT_onset, RT_critical 均违反 ✗；ACC 边界 p = .052 ✓
```

```{r}
library(interactions)

# 对每个 DV 建含交互的模型
model_IES_onset <- lm(mean_IES_onset ~ group * mean_T_encode, data = ex_all)
summary(model_IES_onset)
Anova(model_IES_onset, type = "III")

# Simple slopes
sim_slopes(model_IES_onset, pred = mean_T_encode, modx = group)

# 可视化
interact_plot(model_IES_onset, pred = mean_T_encode, modx = group,
              x.label = "T_encode", y.label = "IES_onset")
```

```{r}
for (dv in c("mean_IES_onset", "mean_IES_critical", 
             "mean_RT_onset", "mean_RT_critical")) {
  cat(paste0("\n=== ", dv, " ===\n"))
  model <- lm(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group * mean_T_encode")), 
              data = ex_all)

}
```

```{r}
#Categorization 和 VoE：T_encode 显著正向预测所有 DV，读题越久效率越低
#Sensorimotor：T_encode 对所有 DV 均不显著，读题时间与表现无关
```

假设检验
正态性违反但 N=765 大样本鲁棒性足够。方差齐性在 IES 和 RT 上违反，但各组样本量接近（261, 258, 246），对结果影响有限。平行性假设在 IES 和 RT 上违反，因此对这些 DV 采用含交互项的回归模型进行分析；ACC 假设满足，直接用 ANCOVA。

主效应（Type III SS）
所有 DV 组间差异均高度显著：

IES_onset：F(2, 761) = 30.32, p < .001
IES_critical：F(2, 761) = 28.63, p < .001
RT_onset：F(2, 761) = 23.34, p < .001
RT_critical：F(2, 761) = 23.34, p < .001
ACC：F(2, 761) = 56.78, p < .001

Post-hoc 两两比较
DV              Sen vs Cat      VoE vs Cat    Sen vs VoE
IES_onset       Sen > Cat ***   VoE < Cat *   Sen > VoE ***
IES_critical    Sen > Cat ***   n.s.          Sen > VoE ***
RT_onset        Sen > Cat ***   n.s.          Sen > VoE ***
RT_critical     Sen > Cat ***   n.s.          Sen > VoE ***
ACC             Sen < Cat ***   VoE > Cat **  Sen < VoE ***


Sensorimotor 组在所有指标上表现最差（RT 最长、IES 最高、ACC 最低），VoE 和 Categorization 表现相近，但在 IES_onset 和 ACC 上 VoE 略优于 Categorization。

T_encode 的调节作用（Simple Slopes）
含交互项的回归模型揭示了一个重要发现：T_encode 对各组的影响方向和强度存在显著差异。

Categorization：T_encode 显著正向预测所有 DV（IES_onset: b = 0.16, p = .02；IES_critical: b = 0.17, p < .001；RT_onset/RT_critical: b = 0.15, p < .001），说明读题时间越长，反应效率越低。
Sensorimotor：T_encode 对所有 DV 均不显著（所有 p > .40），说明读题时间长短不影响该组的反应效率。
VoE：T_encode 对所有 DV 均显著正向预测（IES_onset: b = 0.26, p = .03；IES_critical: b = 0.25, p < .001；RT_onset/RT_critical: b = 0.21, p < .001），且斜率最大，说明读题时间对 VoE 组效率的负面影响最强。


综合解读
三组任务的整体效率排序为 VoE ≈ Categorization > Sensorimotor，Sensorimotor 组在所有指标上均显著差于其他两组。
T_encode 的调节作用揭示了三组任务的认知机制差异：Categorization 和 VoE 任务中，读题时间反映了认知加工负荷，读题越久意味着理解越困难，进而影响后续判断效率。而 Sensorimotor 任务中读题时间与表现无关，提示该任务可能更依赖直觉感知或自动化加工，题目理解本身不构成主要瓶颈，任务难度可能主要来自视觉-运动判断本身而非语言理解。 


```{r}
library(car)
library(interactions)

# ── Log 变换 ─────────────────────────────────────────
ex_all$log_IES_onset    <- log(ex_all$mean_IES_onset)
ex_all$log_IES_critical <- log(ex_all$mean_IES_critical)
ex_all$log_RT_onset     <- log(ex_all$mean_RT_onset)
ex_all$log_RT_critical  <- log(ex_all$mean_RT_critical)
ex_all$log_T_encode     <- log(ex_all$mean_T_encode)

# ── Shapiro-Wilk ─────────────────────────────────────
cat("=== Shapiro-Wilk after log transformation ===\n")
for (dv in c("log_IES_onset", "log_IES_critical", 
             "log_RT_onset", "log_RT_critical", "log_T_encode")) {
  sw <- shapiro.test(ex_all[[dv]])
  cat(paste0(dv, ": W = ", round(sw$statistic, 4),
             ", p = ", format(sw$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
}

# ── 相关性检验 ────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Pearson 相关：log_T_encode vs 各 DV ===\n")
for (dv in c("log_IES_onset", "log_IES_critical",
             "log_RT_onset", "log_RT_critical")) {
  result <- cor.test(ex_all$log_T_encode, ex_all[[dv]])
  cat(paste0("\nlog_T_encode vs ", dv, ":\n"))
  cat(paste0("r = ", round(result$estimate, 3),
             ", t(", result$parameter, ") = ", round(result$statistic, 3),
             ", p = ", format(result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
}

# ACC 用 Pearson 原始值
cat("\n=== Pearson 相关：T_encode vs ACC ===\n")
result <- cor.test(ex_all$mean_T_encode, ex_all$mean_ACC)
cat(paste0("r = ", round(result$estimate, 3),
           ", t(", result$parameter, ") = ", round(result$statistic, 3),
           ", p = ", format(result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))

# ── ANCOVA 函수 ───────────────────────────────────────
run_ancova_log <- function(dv, covariate = "log_T_encode", data = ex_all) {
  cat(paste0("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("DV = ", dv, "\n"))
  cat(paste0(strrep("=", 50), "\n"))

  cat("\n--- Levene's Test ---\n")
  print(leveneTest(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group")), data = data))

  cat("\n--- 平行性假设 ---\n")
  print(summary(aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group * ", covariate)),
                    data = data)))

  cat("\n--- ANCOVA ---\n")
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group + ", covariate)),
               data = data)
  print(summary(model))

  cat("\n--- Type III SS ---\n")
  print(Anova(model, type = "III"))

  cat("\n--- Post-hoc Tukey HSD ---\n")
  print(TukeyHSD(model, "group"))
}

# ── 跑所有 DV ─────────────────────────────────────────
run_ancova_log("log_IES_onset")
run_ancova_log("log_IES_critical")
run_ancova_log("log_RT_onset")
run_ancova_log("log_RT_critical")

# ACC 用原始值
run_ancova_log("mean_ACC", covariate = "mean_T_encode")
```

```{r}
library(interactions)

# ── 平行性假设违反 → 交互模型 + Simple Slopes ──────────
dvs_log <- c("log_IES_onset", "log_IES_critical", 
             "log_RT_onset", "log_RT_critical")

for (dv in dvs_log) {
  cat(paste0("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("=== 交互模型: DV = ", dv, " ===\n"))
  cat(paste0(strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  
  model <- lm(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group * log_T_encode")),
              data = ex_all)
  
  cat("\n--- Type III SS ---\n")
  print(Anova(model, type = "III"))
  
  cat("\n--- Simple Slopes ---\n")
  print(sim_slopes(model, pred = log_T_encode, modx = group))
  
  cat("\n--- Post-hoc ---\n")
  print(TukeyHSD(aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group + log_T_encode")),
                     data = ex_all), "group"))
}
```

Log 变换后交互模型结果解读：
与原始值分析结论高度一致，验证了结果的稳健性。

log_IES_onset

group × log_T_encode 交互显著，F(2, 759) = 20.45, p < .001
Simple slopes：Cat (b = +0.10, p < .001) 和 VoE (b = +0.07, p < .001) 显著正向，Sensor (b = -0.04, p = .007) 显著负向
Post-hoc：Sensor > Cat (p < .001)，VoE < Cat (p = .007)，Sensor > VoE (p < .001)


log_IES_critical

group × log_T_encode 交互显著，F(2, 759) = 20.11, p < .001
Simple slopes：Cat (b = +0.29, p < .001) 和 VoE (b = +0.19, p < .001) 显著正向，Sensor 不显著 (b = -0.02, p = .463)
Post-hoc：Sensor > Cat (p < .001)，VoE < Cat (p = .008)，Sensor > VoE (p < .001)


log_RT_onset

group × log_T_encode 交互显著，F(2, 759) = 17.89, p < .001
Simple slopes：Cat (b = +0.09, p < .001) 和 VoE (b = +0.06, p < .001) 显著正向，Sensor 不显著 (b = 0.00, p = .692)
Post-hoc：Sensor > Cat (p < .001)，VoE vs Cat 不显著 (p = .128)，Sensor > VoE (p < .001)


log_RT_critical

group × log_T_encode 交互显著，F(2, 759) = 16.38, p < .001
Simple slopes：Cat (b = +0.28, p < .001) 和 VoE (b = +0.18, p < .001) 显著正向，Sensor 不显著 (b = +0.01, p = .663)
Post-hoc：Sensor > Cat (p < .001)，VoE < Cat (p = .047)，Sensor > VoE (p < .001)

DV                  Sen vs Cat       VoE vs Cat       Sen vs VoE
IES_onset（原始）   Sen > Cat ***    VoE < Cat *      Sen > VoE ***
IES_onset（log）    Sen > Cat ***    VoE < Cat **     Sen > VoE ***
IES_critical（原始）Sen > Cat ***    n.s.             Sen > VoE ***
IES_critical（log） Sen > Cat ***    VoE < Cat **     Sen > VoE ***
RT_onset（原始）    Sen > Cat ***    n.s.             Sen > VoE ***
RT_onset（log）     Sen > Cat ***    n.s.             Sen > VoE ***
RT_critical（原始） Sen > Cat ***    n.s.             Sen > VoE ***
RT_critical（log）  Sen > Cat ***    VoE < Cat *      Sen > VoE ***


主要差异：
IES_critical：VoE vs Cat

原始值：不显著 (p = .092)
Log 变换：显著 (p = .008)，VoE < Cat
原因：log 变换压缩了极端值，减小了组内方差，提高了检验效力

RT_critical：VoE vs Cat

原始值：不显著 (p = .217)
Log 变换：显著 (p = .047)，VoE < Cat
原因：同上，log 变换对右偏数据的极端值影响较大

Simple Slopes 差异：
DV           Cat      Cat       Sensor      Sensor     VoE        VoE
             原始     log       原始        log        原始       log
IES_onset.   +0.16*.  +0.10***. -0.04n.s.   -0.04*.    +0.26*     +0.07** IES_critical +0.17*** +0.29***.  0.00 n.s.  -0.02n.s.  +0.25**.   +0.19** RT_onset.    +0.15*** +0.09***. +0.02 n.s.  .0.00n.s.  +0.21***.  +0.06*** RT_critical. +0.15*** +0.28***. +0.02 n.s.   +0.01n.s. +0.21***.  +0.18***


核心模式一致：

Cat 和 VoE：两种分析下斜率均显著正向，T_encode 越长效率越低
Sensor：两种分析下斜率均不显著，T_encode 对表现无预测作用
Log 变换后斜率数值有所变化（因量纲不同），但方向和显著性模式高度一致

结论：
Log 变换后结论与原始值分析高度一致，支持将原始值分析作为主要结果报告，log 变换版本放入附录作为稳健性检验。唯一细微差异是 log_IES_onset 中 Sensor 的斜率变为显著负向，但整体模式不变。


```{r}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# ── Step 1: 整理原始数据长格式 ───────────────────────
plot_dat_ex <- ex_all %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "VoE", "Sensorimotor"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical,
                mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, mean_ACC) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical,
             mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, mean_ACC),
    names_to  = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "mean_IES_onset"    ~ "IES[onset]",
      measure == "mean_IES_critical" ~ "IES[critical]",
      measure == "mean_RT_onset"     ~ "RT[onset]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_critical"  ~ "RT[critical]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_ACC"          ~ "ACC~('%')"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c(
      "IES[onset]", "IES[critical]",
      "RT[onset]~(s)", "RT[critical]~(s)", "ACC~('%')"
    ))
  )

# ── Step 2: 计算均值和 SEM ────────────────────────────
sem_dat_ex <- plot_dat_ex %>%
  group_by(group, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem  = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: 显著性标注（正式实验，按你之前的设定）─────
comparisons_list_ex <- list(
  "IES[onset]"       = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "***"),
                            list(c("Categorization", "VoE"),          "**"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"),            "***")),
  "IES[critical]"    = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "***"),
                            list(c("Categorization", "VoE"),          "**"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"),            "***")),
  "RT[onset]~(s)"    = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "***"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"),            "***")),
  "RT[critical]~(s)" = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "***"),
                            list(c("Categorization", "VoE"),          "*"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"),            "***")),
  "ACC~('%')"        = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "***"),
                            list(c("Categorization", "VoE"),          "**"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"),            "***"))
)

# ── Step 4: 配色与标签映射 ───────────────────────────
nature_colors <- c(
  "Categorization" = "#4DBBD5",
  "VoE"            = "#00A087",
  "Sensorimotor"   = "#E64B35"
)
group_labels <- c(
  "Categorization" = "Concept Verification",
  "VoE"            = "Plausibility Assessment",
  "Sensorimotor"   = "Affordance Recognition"
)

# ── Step 5: 抽取横向 legend ──────────────────────────
legend_plot <- ggplot(sem_dat_ex, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = nature_colors,
    labels = group_labels,
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size  = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 2, b = 2)
  )

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# ── Step 6: 循环画每个子图 ───────────────────────────
plot_list <- list()

for (m in levels(sem_dat_ex$measure)) {
  d      <- sem_dat_ex %>% filter(measure == m)
  comps  <- lapply(comparisons_list_ex[[m]], `[[`, 1)
  labels <- lapply(comparisons_list_ex[[m]], `[[`, 2)
  y_max  <- max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.5

  p_sub <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group)) +

    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +

    geom_signif(
      comparisons = comps,
      annotations = unlist(labels),
      y_position  = seq(max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.1,
                        max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.35,
                        length.out = length(comps)),
      tip_length  = 0.02,
      textsize    = 3,
      vjust       = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = nature_colors,
      labels = group_labels,
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, y_max)) +

    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = parse(text = m)) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.line       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.y    = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      plot.margin     = margin(6, 4, 4, 4)
    )

  plot_list[[m]] <- p_sub
}

# ── Step 7: 合并：5个子图一行，legend 放最底部 ───────
combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, ncol = 5, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size   = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.margin     = margin(t = -2, b = 0),
    plot.margin       = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

print(combined)

# ── Step 8: 保存 ─────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "pilot_barchart.pdf"),
  plot     = combined,
  width    = 200,
  height   = 90,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "pilot_barchart.png"),
  plot     = combined,
  width    = 200,
  height   = 90,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)
cat("图已保存！\n")
```
